name: 联邦技术工人计划
summary: 面向具有加拿大境内或境外技术工作经验的申请人。满足最低门槛后还须在六项甄选因素中达到 67 分，进入 Express Entry 候选池也不保证获得邀请。
summaryEn: For skilled workers with Canadian or foreign work experience. Applicants who meet the minimum requirements must also score at least 67 points across six selection factors; entering the Express Entry pool does not guarantee an invitation.

workExperience.summary: 最近 10 年内，在同一主要职业 NOC 的 TEER 0、1、2 或 3 类中，至少完成连续 1 年、合计 1,560 小时的有偿工作，并符合该 NOC 的职责要求。
workExperience.summaryEn: At least 1 continuous year (1,560 hours) of paid work within the last 10 years in the same primary NOC, in TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3, while meeting the NOC duty requirements.

language.summary: 经认可的英语或法语考试，第一官方语言四项能力均至少达到 CLB 7 或 NCLC 7。
language.summaryEn: An approved English or French test with at least CLB 7 or NCLC 7 in all four abilities for the first official language.

education.summary: 须有加拿大高中或高等教育证书、文凭或学位；境外学历须提供完成的学历证书和移民用途学历认证（ECA）。
education.summaryEn: A Canadian secondary or post-secondary credential is required; foreign education requires both a completed credential and an Educational Credential Assessment for immigration purposes.

jobOffer.summary: 工作邀请不是最低资格条件，但符合要求的工作邀请可计入该计划的甄选因素。自 2025 年 3 月 25 日起，工作邀请不再获得 CRS 加分。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A job offer is not a minimum eligibility requirement, though a valid offer may count toward the program's selection factors. Job-offer CRS points were removed on March 25, 2025.

settlementFunds.summary: 通常需要资金证明；如获授权在加拿大工作且有有效工作邀请，则无需提供。金额会定期更新，应在申请时查询官网。
settlementFunds.summaryEn: Proof of funds is generally required, unless the applicant is authorized to work in Canada and has a valid job offer. Amounts change periodically and should be checked at application time.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
